definitions.explanation: The power or freedom to make decisions based on one's own judgment.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{件|けん}→件：11720_ken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{裁量|さいりょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{任|まか}せる→任せる：02417_makaseru⟧。
examples.english: I'll leave this matter to the department head's discretion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{裁量|さいりょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please handle it at your discretion on site.

examples.japanese: {裁量|さいりょう}{労働制|ろうどうせい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I work under a discretionary labor system.

notes:
FORMS:
{裁|さい} (judge, decide) + ⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧ (measure) → to measure and decide = discretion

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {裁量|さいりょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{任|まか}せる→任せる：02417_makaseru⟧ - to leave to someone's discretion
- {裁量|さいりょう}{権|けん} - discretionary power
- {裁量|さいりょう}{労働制|ろうどうせい} - discretionary work system
- ⟦{自|みずか}ら→自ら：00287_mizukara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{裁量|さいりょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ - at one's own discretion

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧ - judgment
- ⟦{決定|けってい}→決定：02701_kettei⟧{権|けん} - decision-making authority
- ⟦{采配|さいはい}→采配：07769_saihai⟧ - direction, command

USAGE:
Common in business and legal contexts. Often discusses the scope of authority one has.
